NOTE
**Still not ready — known bug left unfixed and no new push**

New: No new code since the feedback, and the comment only says "ready" without explaining what changed. The PR's own test notes admit that collapsing a message and then muting the sender still fails: "Show more" appears but the message stays hidden. Missing: a fix or clear plan for that case (the issue wants collapsed state tracked even when hidden), and precise before/after screenshots as the guide describes.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready"; laurynmm, who gave the first feedback, can follow up, and no reviewer is assigned yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! I don't see a new push, and your own Test 2 notes say that collapsing then muting still doesn't work, so please fix that case and make sure the before/after screenshots follow [the guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots), one clear pair per scenario.
```
